newsitem.title: UGANDA: Yields up on benchmark Uganda treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields up on benchmark Uganda treasury bills.

text.p: The central bank of Uganda on Thursday raised the average yield on two of its key treasury bills after their demand fell, bank officials said.
The Bank of Uganda sold the 91-day treasury bill at 10.068 percent, up from 9.97 percent and 273-day bills at an average yield of 13.782 percent from 13.7 percent.
Average yields on secondary 182-day and 364-day treasury bills eased marginally on a slight increase in demand.
The 182-day bill sold at 12.66 percent from 12.83 percent while the 364-day bill sold at 14.002 percent from 14.38 percent.
The bank sold 6.5 billion shillings ($6 million) of the 91-day treasury bill.
